notes: One upload per file through Open Cloud POST /assets/v1/assets. Never re-upload a file listed here; reuse its id.

importerImages: images the Open Cloud importer uploaded implicitly from the GLBs' embedded textures. Their ColorMap/NormalMap are pixel-identical to the PNGs and are used as is (no separate upload). The importer's RoughnessMap is the packed glTF metallicRoughness G channel at its embedded size: half the PNG size for A (Spruce, Oak, Cabin, CabinRoof) and B (all four), so those eight grayscale PNGs were uploaded; for A Boulder and all of C the embedded map is full size and pixel-identical, so the importer's image is used.
Ground tiles: all 18 PNGs uploaded once; used only by the MaterialVariants MaterialService.StyleTest.StyleTest_<V>_<Pebble|ForestFloor> on test slabs.

studio.builder: ServerStorage.StyleTest.StyleTestBuilder (+ Manifest child); repo copies art/manifests/StyleTest.luau and StyleTest.Manifest.luau
studio.materialVariants: MaterialService.StyleTest.StyleTest_<V>_Pebble / StyleTest_<V>_ForestFloor, BaseMaterial Ground; used only by Workspace.StyleTest slabs
studio.diorama: Workspace.StyleTest (Scene_A z +260, Scene_B z 0, Scene_C z -260 at x 7000, ground y 302) on a 1200 x 12 x 1200 grass pad centred (7000, 296, 0)
studio.importFindings: All three imports were turned 180 degrees about Y (undone on the copies). AlphaMode came in as Overlay on every part, which is what the manifests ask (no cut-out cards in these sets). The importer roughness was half size for A Spruce/Oak/Cabin/CabinRoof and all of B, and full size for A Boulder and all of C. Parts arrived grey Plastic, unanchored, Default collision.
